public_feedback.scope: Public request inputs only; no held-out verdict is supplied.

blocks.correspondence: This initialization block sets the model's initial values: all listed state variables except enabled are first set to 0, enabled is set to 1, and a is then set to 65535.
The ISR assigns 65536 to a, matching the model's interrupt assignment.
This is the first atomic foreground STEP. It copies a into c, matching the model assignment.

This is the second atomic foreground STEP. Its guarded cast narrows c to uint16_t before assigning d, and then sets bad according to whether d is zero. The model represents the narrowing as c & 65535 and the comparison as d == 0.
